hadith:
Sales and Trade - Narrated Ibn `Abbas:

`Ukaz, Majanna and Dhul-Majaz were markets in the Pre-Islamic period. When the people embraced Islam they considered it a sin to trade there. So, the following Holy Verse came:-- 'There is no harm for you if you seek of the bounty of your Lord (Allah) in the Hajj season." (2.198) Ibn `Abbas recited it like this.
message: Allah alone owns all that is in the heavens and earth, so place your trust in Him rather than assumptions. Call upon Al-Mujeeb with sincerity, and remember that seeking provision through trade during Hajj is not a sin.
name:
Al Mujeeb - الْمُجِيبُ - The Responsive

Al Mujeeb describes Allah's response to those who call upon Him. He is near to His servants and hears their supplications. This name encourages sincere prayer and patient trust in His wisdom and mercy.
verse:
Yunus - Jonah - 10:66

Certainly to Allah ˹alone˺ belong all those in the heavens and all those on the earth. And what do those who associate others with Allah really follow? They follow nothing but assumptions and do nothing but lie.
